title: In the Rust crate `crates/ui/aura-ui-terminal` (ratatui + crossterm TUI), two features were just implemented (uncommitt…

items.content: App key tests: newline keys, empty input, login unaffected, Up/Down lines + history
App mouse tests: stop button click cancels, left-of-button does not, approval case
Renderer tests: stop button busy/idle, no overlap, input height with newlines

summary: I've added 15 tests (10 app-level, 5 renderer) and they all pass. They found no bugs in the two features, and I changed no production code. The full test suite and clippy still fail, though, because of someone else's unfinished work in the same crate.
